answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded collateral escrows that link accountability to capital, not merely identity count. If k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus event, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k²), so adding aliases increases exposure rather than dividing it. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation making recovery slower than forfeiture. A forge, raven, or pulse of fabricated identities cannot cheaply dilute that risk.
